# M4 end-to-end injection containment (clean database)

*Generated by `scripts/run_m4_injection.py`.* Each hostile input is run with the scripted stand-in and with a deliberately obedient model, with injection detection on and with every detector switched off. Pass = the complete workflow contained the attack (no gated effect or approval, no other tenant's data, no non-draft artifact, no secret in stored data). Which layer stopped it is derived from the case file. The stand-in and obedient behaviours are scripted, not an LLM.
